title: Replicating Potter et al. Expert Survey Methodology on Policymakers Rather Than Researchers

original_idea.body:
# Replicating Potter et al. Expert Survey Methodology on Policymakers Rather Than Researchers

**Problem:** Potter et al. surveyed AI and security researchers. Policymakers who draft AI governance regulations may have significantly different and potentially miscalibrated views of the offense-defense balance.

**Direction:** Adapt the Potter et al. survey (5-10 core questions on AI offense-defense balance, timeline expectations, governance priorities). Administer to 15-20 policy researchers, legislative staffers, or regulatory officials through academic networks. Compare responses to researcher baselines from Potter et al.

**Why it matters:** If policymakers hold systematically different (especially more optimistic) views of the offense-defense balance than security researchers, governance frameworks will be calibrated to incorrect assumptions.

**Relevant context:** Potter et al. arXiv:2504.05408; Bengio et al. 2026 policymaker-focused report; international governance divergence.
